sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Deepthi Priyanka T.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 15-10- 2021.

After the marriage, the accused have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by quarreling with her, abusing her in filthy language and compelling her to hand over all her salary to the accused.
The accused used to suspect her character and used to record all the phone call received by CW-1, and suspect CW-1 of having illicit relationship with her brother.
It is further alleged that after the marriage, accused has stated that they have incurred lot of debt for the marriage and in order to repay the debt, accused demanded and took Rs.8,39,000/-.

Based on the said information,
a case in Cr.No.299/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused  3  C.C.No.25671/2023 for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: The plea of the accused was recorded.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

The following points arise for my determination:-

Sec. 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?

10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Deepthi Priyanka.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 15-10-2021 and deposed after the  5  C.C.No.25671/2023 marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and deposed accused did not abused and threatened to kill her. PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

sentences.text: As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504, 506 of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
